marks.gloss_en: איכא דרמי לה מירמא: תנן ציני הר הברזל כשר, והתניא פסולה!
אמר אביי, לא קשיא: כאן שראשו של זה מגיע לצד עיקרו של זה, כאן שאין ראשו של זה מגיע לצד עיקרו של זה (= p_kan_mishnah_magia, p_kan_baraita_ein_magia, reported by the איכא דרמי tradition)
Abaye (in the איכא דרמי version): here [the mishnah, valid] -- where the tip of this one reaches the base of that one
there are two date palms in the valley of ben Hinnom, and smoke rises from between them
הא גופא קשיא: you said most leaves fell -- fit, and then 'provided its avot remains'; once two [of three] fall, how can avot be found? (internal contradiction; kind svara, header)
משכחת לה באסא מצראה דקיימי שבעה שבעה בחד קינא (= p_abaye_asa_mitzraa)
Abaye: you find it in the Egyptian myrtle, where seven [and] seven stand in one base: when four fall, three remain
בעינן עבות, וליכא -- we need 'avot', and it is lacking
'boughs of a thick tree' -- whose branches cover its wood
בעינן ענפיו חופין את עצו, וליכא -- we need branches covering its wood, and it is lacking
(candidate) say it is the dulba
דרכיה דרכי נעם, וליכא (= p_abaye_darkei_noam)
מהכא: האמת והשלום אהבו (= p_rava_emet_shalom)
(candidate) say it is the hirduf
plaited like a braid and resembling a chain -- that is the myrtle
a thick [myrtle] -- fit
Rav Yehuda: provided three [and] three leaves stand in a base
most of its leaves fell and a minority remained -- fit
a stolen myrtle is unfit
דאמר רב הונא אמר שמואל: הלכה כרבי טרפון -- Shmuel's real measure is R' Tarfon's (two and a half on Ravin's reading), so his 'three' errs toward stringency
לא דק, והיינו לחומרא לא דק, דאמר רב הונא אמר שמואל הלכה כרבי טרפון (= p_lo_dak_lechumra_hadas)
[Shmuel] was not precise, and this is imprecision toward stringency (three against two and a half)
תנן: לולב שיש בו שלשה טפחים כדי לנענע בו כשר! -- the mishnah validates a three-handbreadth lulav, against the four of Shmuel and of R' Yochanan alike
אימא: וכדי לנענע בו כשר (= p_eima_ukhdei_lenanea); מר כדאית ליה ומר כדאית ליה -- each master reads the extra handbreadth by his own view
the emendation: read [three handbreadths] AND enough to wave with -- valid
תא שמע: שיעור הדס וערבה שלשה ולולב ארבעה -- מאי לאו בהדי עלין? is the baraita's four not with the leaves?
לא, לבד מעלין -- no: apart from the leaves

קשיא דשמואל אדשמואל: here Rav Yehuda-Shmuel says myrtle and willow three, there Rav Huna-Shmuel says the halakha follows R' Tarfon (three and three fifths on Rav Dimi's reading). Its first answer, לא דק, falls (p_lo_dak_lekula_hadas, obj_lo_dak_lekula); re-raised at 32b.12 as סוף סוף קשיא on Ravin's two and a half
אימר דאמרינן לא דק לחומרא, לקולא מי אמרינן לא דק?! -- 'not precise' is said toward stringency; toward leniency?
Shmuel: the halakha follows R' Tarfon
the mishnah: a lulav that has three handbreadths, enough to wave with, is valid
R' Yochanan: the lulav's spine must extend a handbreadth beyond the myrtle
R' Tarfon: with a cubit of five handbreadths (gloss-only: what it measures is what the readings below dispute)
Rava: may his Master forgive R' Tarfon -- now a dense [myrtle] of three we do not find; one of five, all the more so
Rav Dimi: make a cubit of six handbreadths into five; take three of them for the myrtle and the rest for the lulav
Ravin: make a cubit of five handbreadths into six; take three of them for the myrtle and the rest for the lulav
